scientific_question: In the single-channel blow-mold flow simulation, consider the complete supplied three-dimensional mesh. Investigate the spatial association between viscosity and shear-rate magnitude. Use all cells, with stored cell values directly and arithmetic means of vertex values for point fields. Measure association by the volume-weighted Pearson correlation. Weight by the absolute signed cell volume from VTK and normalize by the included volume. Select and explain findings that characterize this scientific target.
